name: Ethan
source:
Paige's brother, Ethan, is the likely the best all around player on his team. While not super talented in any one aspect, he rarely misses a set up and he's always the first back to help cover defensively. Even his weakest skills are better than most. He always looks out for Paige, dealing with and covering for her when she loses her temper.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=37386]Lemmasoftl[/url]]
